must_contain: the catalogue's term is LMIS, not LIMS
LMIS is NHA's term for laboratory software
an LMIS is the provider facing side of the HIE-CM, the same side an HMIS sits on
an LMIS acts as a HIP when it publishes a report and as an HIU when it reads a patient's history
notes: reader typed LIMS; we expect the answer to target LMIS (laboratory management information system), NHA's term for provider-side lab software. A separate real atom, shared.glossary.lims (laboratory information management system), also exists for a different meaning; the lmis atom itself warns that searching one spelling and concluding the other does not exist is a common mistake, so an answer that also names LIMS by way of disambiguation is acceptable.
